methodology.source: Deterministic simulation against the production SnapshotTiming implementation. Synthetic arrival patterns are controlled test inputs, not measured internet latency.

scenarios.name: Stable 30 Hz delivery
scenarios.description: Fixed 55 ms one-way model; no arrival variation.

scenarios.name: Low consumer jitter
scenarios.description: Deterministic ±4 ms arrival variation around the same 55 ms one-way model.

scenarios.name: Moderate jitter burst
scenarios.description: Steady stream with an 80 ms ordered-delivery stall at frame 90; queued snapshots then arrive as an ordered batch.

scenarios.name: Severe ordered stall
scenarios.description: Steady stream with a 180 ms ordered-delivery stall at frame 90; queued snapshots then arrive as an ordered batch.
